title: loonfs-server values
description: The schema rejects value names it does not know, at every level the chart owns. A misspelled name fails the lint and the install instead of being ignored, which is the rule the server applies to its own TOML config.
$comment: The required lists name what the templates read directly. Everything else is optional, because the templates skip it when it is absent.

repository.description: The repository to pull the server image from.

tag.description: The tag to run. Empty means the chart's appVersion.

digest.description: A digest, written as sha256:... . Setting it ignores the tag.

pullPolicy.description: The container's imagePullPolicy. Kubernetes accepts these three.

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets for a private registry.

existingSecret.description: The name of an existing Secret holding the server config. The chart does not create it, so the install needs a name.

key.description: The entry in that Secret holding the TOML config. The container reads /etc/loonfs/<key>.

port.description: The port the Service publishes and the probes call. The config's bind has to name the same number.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: How long the kubelet waits after SIGTERM before it sends SIGKILL.

enabled.description: Mount an emptyDir at /var/cache/loonfs for the server's disk cache.

sizeLimit.description: The emptyDir's sizeLimit, as a quantity such as 100Gi. Empty means no limit.

extraEnv.description: Environment variables for the container. Each entry is a Kubernetes EnvVar, and the chart passes it through as written.

extraEnvFrom.description: Environment sources for the container. Each entry is a Kubernetes EnvFromSource, and the chart passes it through as written.

tolerations.description: Passed through as written. Each entry is a Kubernetes Toleration.

affinity.description: Passed through as written, as a Kubernetes Affinity.

resources.description: Passed through as written, as a Kubernetes ResourceRequirements.
